Type: L-shaped sectional sofa

Materials: woven performance-look fabric, loose back cushions, hidden base

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Devonshire Modern Farmhouse Sectional Sofa Couch, 114"W, Putty
product.description: This spacious sectional sofa makes a modern but down-to-earth design statement in your living room or family room. The foam-padded cushions are loose and reversible, providing the ultimate in comfort and durability. Putty-colored performance upholstery is easy to care for and maintain. 114"W x 78.5"D x 35.5"H; seat height: 21.5"H; seat depth: 27.5"D; seat back height: 29"H; arm height: 29"H; leg height: 1.78"H Upholstered in 100% polyester fabric; fully padded solid wood frame with mortise and tenon construction Removable and reversible back and seat cushions; sinuous spring support system with durable foam-padded cushions Assemble in 15 minutes or less Spills should be spot cleaned and rinsed with water. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty. This item is made to order just for you.
